title: pyrethrum segetum
intro: Pyrethrum segetum, commonly known as Chrysanthemum segetum, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pyrethrum segetum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
